summary: Iteration 6 e2e verification of Everkin: multi-file upload + AI auto-classification, doc-grounded chat with source chips/preview/download, Investments page, and regressions (nav, plain chat, insurance, insights). Backend: 12/13 pytest assertions pass (new suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py). Frontend: all requested flows work in the browser EXCEPT the source preview modal cannot render text/CSV documents (shows 'Preview not available for this file type'), which contradicts the requested 'text snippet' preview. All QA data cleaned up.

minor.issue: Returns 200 {ok:true} for a non-existent id (routes.py:743 delete_one without deleted_count check). PUT on same resource correctly 404s — inconsistent.
Same pattern: update_one without matched_count check, so unknown/foreign document ids return 200 instead of 404.
auto_classified is set True whenever auto_classify/category=auto is sent, even when Gemini classification fails and metadata is empty — Vault then shows an 'AI' badge with no extracted metadata.

ui_bugs.issue: For text/plain and text/csv source documents (the exact fixtures used for visa/statement grounding) the modal body shows 'Preview not available for this file type. Use download to open it.' — no text snippet is rendered. Only image/* and pdf are handled (Chat.jsx lines 335-343). The requested feature was image/PDF/TEXT SNIPPET preview. Download button works.

If a cited document was later deleted, GET /documents/{id}/download returns 404 and the modal flashes open then closes with a generic 'Could not load document' toast. Reproduced with a soft-deleted doc cited in a persisted message. Should render an inline 'document no longer available' state in the modal.

On /chat first load, loadConvos() auto-selects the newest conversation asynchronously. Clicking 'New chat' while that request is in flight renders the OLD conversation's messages (and its source chips) inside the brand-new conversation. Reproduced once — old assistant reply + stale chip appeared in a new chat. Guard selectConvo response against the current activeId.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' on the statement <select> (Insights.jsx:65-67) — likely dev-instrumentation wrapping, but worth confirming it does not ship.

action_items: Render a text snippet in the chat doc-preview modal for text/*, csv and json content types (fetch blob -> text -> <pre> with max height); currently the primary new feature's preview is unusable for text documents.
Handle 404/deleted documents in openPreview with an in-modal message instead of closing the modal.
Fix the /chat new-conversation vs auto-select race so stale messages/source chips cannot appear in a fresh conversation.
Return 404 from DELETE /api/investments/{id} and DELETE /api/documents/{id} when nothing matched.
Only set auto_classified=True when classification actually produced a category/metadata.
critical_code_review_comments: Chat.jsx preview branch has no text/* handler — the feature spec explicitly asked for a text snippet preview.

routes.py select_relevant_docs() matches only filename/category/metadata keywords, so a document whose content is relevant but whose filename/metadata lack the keyword will never be cited (no content-level search). Acceptable for now but limits grounding recall.

Every uploaded document is passed to Gemini synchronously inside the upload request (classify_document), so a 3-file upload serially blocks for 10-30s; consider background classification with a pending state.
routes.py is 774 lines and mixes chat, documents, insights, investments — split into routers per domain.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (all flows pass; text/CSV preview body unsupported)

seed_data_creation: Created fixtures passport_qa.txt (3 visas w/ control numbers) and statement_qa.csv (8 rows, 4 expenses >1500) under /app/test_reports. Uploaded them to demo@example.com's vault, created 1 investment (TEST_QA Gold ETF), 1 insurance policy (TEST_QA Insurer) and several conversations — ALL deleted afterwards via /app/test_reports/cleanup_it6.py (docs/investments/conversations now 0 for the demo user; older TEST_* seeded docs were also removed).
test_credentials: demo@example.com / demo123 (login verified, no lockout triggered)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified working in UI: multi-select upload (button shows 'Uploading & classifying 1/2…', toast '2 documents uploaded'), AI badge + meta-<id> summary lines, grounded chat quoting exact visa lines (US99881/UK55221/FR11009) with [doc:ID] stripped, message-sources chip -> doc-preview modal -> preview-download (download event fired, file passport_qa.txt), plain chat streams with 0 sources rows, Investments add/summary(Net Worth 7,500 / ROI 25%)/delete, Insurance add+delete (testids are form-provider/form-policy-number/form-sum-assured, NOT policy-*), Insights analyze produced full spend breakdown. Demo user's vault is now EMPTY — re-upload fixtures from /app/test_reports before re-testing grounded chat. Beware /chat auto-selects the newest conversation ~2-4s after load; wait before clicking 'New chat'.
rca_of_the_issue: Text preview gap: Chat.jsx renders for image/*,
